newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Wuerth Finance Intl's SFr100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Wuerth Finance Intl's SFr100 mln bond.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned Wuerth Finance International's 100 million Swiss franc bond due 2005 an A minus rating.
"The rating is based on the respective unconditional and irrevocable guarantee provided by Adolf Wuerth GmbH & Co. KG," S&P said in a statement.
Wuerth Finance International B.V. is the financial vehicle for the German and foreign operations of Wuerth Group. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Reinhold Wuerth Holding.
S&P said the outlook was stable.

"The stable outlook is based on Standard & Poor's expectation that Wuerth's trend of gradual expansion to consolidate its leading position within an underdeveloped and fragmented industry will continue to support the maintenance of steady earnings growth and cash flow generation," S&P said.
It said the rating reflected the strong industry position of Wuerth Group and its satisfactory financial condition.
